summary: Site 113 is a quiet park shared path (about 10-20 bikes/day per direction, daylight only) with one piezo counter from 2011-07 to 2021-09; the data is sound apart from the counter's failure in 2021. From March 2021 it failed repeatedly, and after 2021-04-28 it records only Friday-afternoon fragments, which are set missing. Many short zero_outage flags on one direction are rainy quiet days (the other direction on the same unit was equally low and was kept), so those are restored; the 874-bike northbound morning peak on 2013-10-13 is a smooth one-way mass ride and stands.
